clips.title: The story
paras: A hidden parchment found aboard the Bloodsail Buccaneer vessels along the Wild Shore presents Cortello's cryptic verse. Deciphering the poem points travelers toward a clue waiting beneath an ornate bridge.

Scattered notes aboard the Bloodsail fleet anchored off the southern coast of Stranglethorn Vale carry a rhyme. Cortello's verse describes a finely worked, much-used bridge that lies east of Deadwind and south of Redridge. Anyone seeking to unravel the mystery must follow these poetic directions out of the jungle and into the marshes to find what waits underneath.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is an ornate, well-traveled bridge
East of Deadwind and south of Redridge
Underneath there waits something for you
Some call it a hint, others a clue
There it will lie for endless tomorrows
Biding its time in the Swamp of Sorrows

clips.title: Completion
paras: The soggy parchment contains the next clue....
